<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ar" dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>IVX – خطة غذائية</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;800&family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@500;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#1c1c1c;--card:#262626;--ink:#f1ede6;--mut:#a8a39a;--or:#ff8a2b;--line:#3a3a3a;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){:root:not([data-theme="dark"]){--bg:#1c1c1c}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Cairo,Tahoma,sans-serif;line-height:1.7}
.bar{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:5;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 12px;background:#111;border-bottom:2px solid var(--or)}
.bar button,.ctl button{font:inherit;font-size:13px;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.bar button:hover,.ctl button:hover{border-color:var(--or)}.bar button:focus-visible,.ctl button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--or)}
.bar .go{background:var(--or);color:#111;border-color:var(--or);font-weight:600}
.wrap{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 14px 40px}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:440px;margin:14px 0;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;background:#000 center/cover no-repeat;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#000d 8%,#0000 70%)}
.hero .in{position:relative;padding:22px;width:100%}
.brand{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;letter-spacing:.35em;font-size:15px;color:var(--or);font-weight:700}
.hero h1{margin:4px 0;font-size:clamp(28px,6vw,46px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.2}
.hero p{margin:0;color:var(--mut)}
.sec{position:relative;background:var(--card);border-inline-start:4px solid var(--or);padding:16px 18px;margin:14px 0;break-inside:avoid}
.sec h2{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:20px;color:var(--or);font-weight:800}
.sec [contenteditable]{outline:none;border-radius:3px}.sec [contenteditable]:focus{background:#ffffff0f}
.sec .body{min-height:1.5em;white-space:pre-wrap}
.ctl{position:absolute;top:8px;inset-inline-end:8px;display:flex;gap:4px}
.ctl button{padding:0 8px;font-size:12px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:6px}
th,td{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 8px;text-align:start;font-size:15px;vertical-align:top}
th{background:#333;color:var(--or);font-weight:600}
.img img{width:100%;display:block;max-height:520px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:3px}
.img.half{max-width:50%;margin-inline:auto}@media(max-width:560px){.img.half{max-width:100%}}
.ph{padding:30px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed var(--mut);color:var(--mut)}
.cap{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;margin-top:6px}
footer{text-align:center;padding:22px 10px;border-top:2px solid var(--or);margin-top:20px}
footer .ic{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}
footer a{color:var(--or);border:1.5px solid var(--or);border-radius:8px;padding:4px 12px;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px}
footer a:hover{background:var(--or);color:#111}
.hint{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;margin:8px 0}
.add{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0}.add button{font:inherit;font-size:14px;background:none;color:var(--or);border:1px dashed var(--or);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer}
@media print{.bar,.ctl,.add,.hint,.rowctl{display:none!important}*{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}@page{size:A4;margin:10mm}table,tr{break-inside:avoid}.hero{min-height:300px}}
</style></head><body>
<div class="bar"><button id="bLang"></button><button id="bSave" class="go"></button><button id="bPrint"></button><button id="bExp"></button><button id="bImp"></button><button id="bReset"></button><input type="file" id="fImp" accept=".json" hidden></div>
<div class="wrap"><div id="root"></div>
<div class="add" id="add"></div>
<footer><div class="brand">IVX · ONLINE COACHING</div><div id="fq" contenteditable="true" style="color:var(--mut)"></div>
<div class="ic" id="soc"></div></footer></div>
<input type="file" id="fImg" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" hidden>
<script>
var IMG={cover:"data:image/jpeg;base64,",b:"data:image/jpeg;base64,",c:"data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
var UI={ar:{lang:"English",save:"حفظ",print:"طباعة / PDF",exp:"تصدير",imp:"استيراد",reset:"قالب جديد",text:"+ نص",table:"+ جدول",img:"+ صورة",half:"نصف",full:"كامل",up:"▲",dn:"▼",del:"✕",row:"+ صف",pic:"اضغط لاختيار صورة",cap:"تعليق على الصورة",foot:"تواصل معي لمتابعة خطتك",hint:"اضغط على أي نص لتعديله. الأزرار الصغيرة على كل قسم للترتيب والحذف.",saved:"تم الحفظ",ask:"سيتم استبدال الخطة الحالية. متابعة؟",lbl:"جديد"},
en:{lang:"عربي",save:"Save",print:"Print / PDF",exp:"Export",imp:"Import",reset:"New template",text:"+ Text",table:"+ Table",img:"+ Image",half:"Half",full:"Full",up:"▲",dn:"▼",del:"✕",row:"+ Row",pic:"Tap to choose an image",cap:"Image caption",foot:"Message me to follow your plan",hint:"Tap any text to edit it. Small buttons on each section reorder or delete it.",saved:"Saved",ask:"This replaces the current plan. Continue?",lbl:"New"}};
var SOC=[["WhatsApp","https://wa.me/20XXXXXXXXXX"],["Facebook","https://facebook.com/YOUR_PAGE"],["TikTok","https://tiktok.com/@YOUR_HANDLE"],["Instagram","https://instagram.com/YOUR_HANDLE"],["Email","mailto:you@example.com"],["Messenger","https://m.me/YOUR_PAGE"]];
function tpl(l){return l=="ar"?{
hero:{h:"الخطة الغذائية",sub:"اسم العميل · التاريخ",src:"cover"},
secs:[
{t:"text",h:"بيانات العميل",b:"الهدف: \nالعمر: \nالوزن: \nالطول: \nمستوى النشاط: "},
{t:"table",h:"الأهداف اليومية",c:[["السعرات","البروتين","الكارب","الدهون"],["","","",""]]},
{t:"table",h:"جدول الوجبات",c:[["الوجبة","الوقت","الأطعمة والكميات","بدائل"],["الأولى","","",""],["الثانية","","",""],["الثالثة","","",""]]},
{t:"text",h:"المكملات والمياه",b:"المياه: 3 لتر يوميا\nالمكملات: "},
{t:"img",src:"b",cap:"",half:0},
{t:"text",h:"ملاحظات وقواعد",b:"• \n• \nالمتابعة: كل أسبوع"}]}:{
hero:{h:"Diet Plan",sub:"Client name · Date",src:"cover"},
secs:[
{t:"text",h:"Client snapshot",b:"Goal: \nAge: \nWeight: \nHeight: \nActivity level: "},
{t:"table",h:"Daily targets",c:[["Calories","Protein","Carbs","Fats"],["","","",""]]},
{t:"table",h:"Meal schedule",c:[["Meal","Time","Foods & quantities","Alternatives"],["Meal 1","","",""],["Meal 2","","",""],["Meal 3","","",""]]},
{t:"text",h:"Supplements & water",b:"Water: 3 L daily\nSupplements: "},
{t:"img",src:"b",cap:"",half:0},
{t:"text",h:"Notes & rules",b:"• \n• \nCheck-in: weekly"}]}}
var S,L="ar",K="ivx_plan_v1";
function load(){try{var r=localStorage.getItem(K);if(r){var o=JSON.parse(r);S=o.s;L=o.l;return}}catch(e){}S=tpl(L)}
function save(q){try{localStorage.setItem(K,JSON.stringify({s:S,l:L}));if(!q)flash(UI[L].saved)}catch(e){if(!q)flash("!")}}
function flash(t){var b=document.getElementById("bSave"),o=UI[L].save;b.textContent=t;setTimeout(function(){b.textContent=o},900)}
function $(i){return document.getElementById(i)}
function el(t,c,x){var e=document.createElement(t);if(c)e.className=c;if(x!=null)e.textContent=x;return e}
function btn(t,f){var b=el("button",0,t);b.type="button";b.onclick=f;return b}
function ed(e,f){e.contentEditable="true";e.oninput=function(){f(e.innerText);save(1)};return e}
function mv(i,d){var j=i+d;if(j<0||j>=S.secs.length)return;var a=S.secs;var x=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=x;save(1);draw()}
function draw(){var u=UI[L],r=$("root");r.innerHTML="";document.documentElement.lang=L;document.documentElement.dir=L=="ar"?"rtl":"ltr";
$("bLang").textContent=u.lang;$("bSave").textContent=u.save;$("bPrint").textContent=u.print;$("bExp").textContent=u.exp;$("bImp").textContent=u.imp;$("bReset").textContent=u.reset;
var H=S.hero,h=el("div","hero");h.style.backgroundImage="url("+(IMG[H.src]||H.src)+")";var n=el("div","in");n.appendChild(el("div","brand","IVX · COACH GEDO"));
var t=ed(el("h1",0,H.h),function(v){H.h=v}),s=ed(el("p",0,H.sub),function(v){H.sub=v});n.append(t,s);h.appendChild(n);
h.title=u.pic;h.style.cursor="pointer";h.onclick=function(ev){if(ev.target==h||ev.target==n)pick(function(d){H.src=d;draw()})};r.appendChild(h);
S.secs.forEach(function(x,i){var c=el("section","sec"),k=el("div","ctl");k.append(btn(u.up,function(){mv(i,-1)}),btn(u.dn,function(){mv(i,1)}),btn(u.del,function(){S.secs.splice(i,1);save(1);draw()}));
if(x.t=="img"){k.prepend(btn(x.half?u.full:u.half,function(){x.half=x.half?0:1;save(1);draw()}))}
c.appendChild(k);
if(x.t!="img")c.appendChild(ed(el("h2",0,x.h),function(v){x.h=v}));
if(x.t=="text"){c.appendChild(ed(el("div","body",x.b),function(v){x.b=v}))}
if(x.t=="table"){var tb=el("table"),tr0=el("tr");x.c.forEach(function(row,ri){var tr=el("tr");row.forEach(function(v,ci){var d=el(ri?"td":"th",0,v);ed(d,function(w){x.c[ri][ci]=w});tr.appendChild(d)});tb.appendChild(tr)});c.appendChild(tb);
var rc=el("div","rowctl");rc.style.marginTop="6px";rc.append(btn(u.row,function(){x.c.push(x.c[0].map(function(){return""}));save(1);draw()}),btn("−",function(){if(x.c.length>2){x.c.pop();save(1);draw()}}));c.appendChild(rc)}
if(x.t=="img"){var w=el("div","img"+(x.half?" half":""));if(x.src){var im=el("img");im.src=IMG[x.src]||x.src;im.alt="";w.appendChild(im)}else w.appendChild(el("div","ph",u.pic));
w.style.cursor="pointer";w.onclick=function(){pick(function(d){x.src=d;draw()})};c.appendChild(w);var cp=ed(el("div","cap",x.cap||u.cap),function(v){x.cap=v});c.appendChild(cp)}
r.appendChild(c)});
$("fq").textContent=S.fq||u.foot;$("fq").oninput=function(){S.fq=$("fq").innerText;save(1)};
var a=$("add");a.innerHTML="";a.append(btn(u.text,function(){S.secs.push({t:"text",h:u.lbl,b:""});save(1);draw()}),btn(u.table,function(){S.secs.push({t:"table",h:u.lbl,c:[["",""],["",""]]});save(1);draw()}),btn(u.img,function(){S.secs.push({t:"img",src:"",cap:"",half:0});save(1);draw()}));
var hh=el("div","hint",u.hint);a.appendChild(hh);hh.style.width="100%"}
function pick(cb){var f=$("fImg");f.value="";f.onchange=function(){var fl=f.files[0];if(!fl)return;var rd=new FileReader();rd.onload=function(){var im=new Image();im.onload=function(){var m=1100,k=Math.min(1,m/Math.max(im.width,im.height)),cv=document.createElement("canvas");cv.width=im.width*k;cv.height=im.height*k;cv.getContext("2d").drawImage(im,0,0,cv.width,cv.height);cb(cv.toDataURL("image/jpeg",.78));save(1)};im.src=rd.result};rd.readAsDataURL(fl)};f.click()}
function soc(){var s=$("soc");SOC.forEach(function(x){var a=el("a",0,x[0]);a.href=x[1];a.target="_blank";a.rel="noopener";s.appendChild(a)})}
$("bLang").onclick=function(){L=L=="ar"?"en":"ar";save(1);draw()};
$("bSave").onclick=function(){save()};$("bPrint").onclick=function(){window.print()};
$("bReset").onclick=function(){if(confirm(UI[L].ask)){S=tpl(L);save(1);draw()}};
$("bExp").onclick=function(){var b=new Blob([JSON.stringify({s:S,l:L})],{type:"application/json"}),a=document.createElement("a");a.href=URL.createObjectURL(b);a.download="ivx-plan.json";a.click()};
$("bImp").onclick=function(){$("fImp").click()};
$("fImp").onchange=function(){var f=this.files[0];if(!f)return;var r=new FileReader();r.onload=function(){try{var o=JSON.parse(r.result);if(o.s&&o.s.secs){S=o.s;L=o.l||L;save(1);draw()}}catch(e){}};r.readAsText(f)};
load();soc();draw();
</script></body></html>
